subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The family laughed, cancelled the order, and changed the settings.”?
options: Grandma still used the assistant, but she learned to check important actions before confirming them.
After that, she still used the app, but she also wrote important dates on a paper calendar.
She still wanted to sing next year, but she had learned something important: a performance needs more than performers.
Fishing boats still used part of the water, and signs explained the harbor's history.

本文沒有陳述「After that, she still used the app, but she also wrote important dates on a paper calendar.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「She still wanted to sing next year, but she had learned something important: a performance needs more than…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
